chk_journal_immutable_posted.name: chk_journal_immutable_posted
chk_journal_immutable_posted.value: CASE WHEN "journal_entries"."status" = 'posted' THEN "journal_entries"."isImmutable" = true ELSE true END

chk_sales_invoice_status_posted_immutabl.name: chk_sales_invoice_status_posted_immutable
chk_sales_invoice_status_posted_immutabl.value:
CASE WHEN "sales_invoices"."status" IN ('paid', 'cancelled') THEN
        "sales_invoices"."postedAt" IS NOT NULL
      ELSE TRUE END
